system.description:
A full suit of gambeson: 1D armor on every location (+1D on the torso), including a matching helmet (Skull Cap or Leather Hood). Clumsy weight: none. No untrained penalty.

Superior quality: only the first 1 counts and it is rerolled; if the reroll is a 1 again, an armor die is lost. Costs 4x a full suit.

Armor test: roll the location’s armor dice vs Ob 1 + the weapon’s VA; meet the obstacle and the blow is warded off. The torso (breastplate) always gets +1D. Shields may be included in an armor kit at no extra cost. Pieces may be bought separately: a helmet or breastplate costs half the full suit; arms (greaves) or leggings a third (round up).

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 474
